notes_for_editor: Thin: the FFLA list says gone; the Central US Lookouts page gives only the county and the code 58N-19W-4, with no history. Two web searches found no build, staffing or removal history for this tower. The page prints the code with no label, so the story calls it a code rather than a land-survey location. The code is roughly consistent with the record coordinates, so no correction is proposed. Suggested sources: St. Louis County Historical Society, MN DNR forestry records, City of Buhl. Story is far below the about-120-word guide length because the sources are thin; a short honest story was preferred to padding.
